config.label: The figure the spending-limit screen suggests for a paid run; the limit is the number the person types
config.description: The figure the spending-limit screen suggests for a paid run; the limit is the number the person types. Unset, a command-line run suggests nothing, and when a client sends no max_usd the MCP server suggests the lesser of 7 and COUNCIL_MAX_USD_LIMIT where that is set. For a chain with no paid seat it is the run's ceiling (7 when unset). A run stops before any stage that could pass its limit.

config.label: A hard per-run ceiling in US dollars that the MCP client cannot raise or remove (max_usd above it, or "none", is refused)
config.description: A hard per-run ceiling in US dollars that the MCP client cannot raise or remove (max_usd above it, or "none", is refused). Set it to the same value as MAX_USD_PER_RUN so the suggested figure and the ceiling are the same.
